reviews.title: Perfect for the cozy gamer girlies!
reviews.comment: As a girl who is just getting back into gaming after quite a few years of not owning a PC and not wanting to break the bank when creating a whole new set up, this monitor is nearly perfect. I wanted something aesthetically pleasing and minimalistic, and this monitor fully delivers on that. It’s lightweight, bigger than expected, I love the slight curve to the screen and visually everything is crisp and clean. It’s keeping up with my mini PC and games that I’m playing. I am someone who is really affected by blue light and the anti-blue light feature is amazing. The only things that are cons for me are: that the screen does not tilt or have any movement to it whatsoever. I also am not entirely sure, but based on reviews that I read I thought that this monitor came with built-in speakers, and there are slits on the bottom of the monitor that look like they could be speakers, but I could not get the sound to work so I had to set up external speakers plugged into my pc. You could totally sync Bluetooth headphones to it, but when I’m gaming for a long periods of time, I like to use external sound rather than headphones. Overall, this is a great monitor, especially if you’re a looking to be a cozy gamer. It’s great quality for the price and won’t break the bank.
